entities.name: St. John the Baptist Cathedral, San Juan
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: San Juan Cathedral, dedicated to Saint John the Baptist, is a cathedral and parish of the Roman Catholic Church in San Juan, Argentina. It is the seat of the metropolitan bishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of San Juan de Cuyo.
